title: Proof of Direct Sum Construction
body_html:
Proof of Direct Sum Construction

The centralizer of the direct-sum semisimple element is the product of the centralizers of the blocks because the blocks have distinct depths. The product building point, product character, and exterior tensor product of finite reductive quotient representations therefore satisfy the defining conditions of a supercuspidal datum. This construction inverts block decomposition at the level of equivalence classes.

deps.title: Block Decomposition of a Supercuspidal Datum
